newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-LIFFE coffee seen moving down.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-LIFFE coffee seen moving down.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Coffee could be facing a sharp fall, technical analysts said.
And traders said it was due to $100 lower, although they reckoned it might only make around $50 down.
Coffee formed a pennant after its fall from highs, Trevor Neil, senior technical analyst at Union Cal Futures, said. And on Thursday it broke down from that pennant, he said.
"It calls for a move down to $1,600 at least," he said, noting that the breakdown was validated by the fact it was on good volume.
He would only abandon a bearish view if it were to close above $1,880, he said.
New York coffee futures ended sharply lower and toward the bottom of the day's range on Thursday, pounded by chart-driven speculative and local selling, dealers said.
On Thursday, LIFFE robusta coffee futures reversed an earlier upward trend to finish with pared losses after New York arabicas took a tumble on chart-driven speculative selling.
No damaging cold is in sight for Brazil's coffee-growing areas for the next five days, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said on Friday.
"The main danger now is that it is so warm that the predicted rains could actually lead to flowerings three months ahead of normal," Brokers GNI said.
